page_title: FRO 0-3 ROM | Frosinone v AS Roma 18/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) fires the ball on goal, but his attempt goes well wide of the left post.
90+3' Frosinone can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

90+2' Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the left side of the goal. However, Mile Svilar anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
90+1' Frosinone quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Abdou Harroui (Frosinone) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.

88' Abdou Harroui (Frosinone) receives a low pass just outside the box and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Mile Svilar pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
88' A substitution has been made. Matias Soule goes off and Demba Seck (Frosinone) comes on.
87' The referee blows his whistle after Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.

86' A sweet pass finds Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball low towards the middle of the goal. Mile Svilar is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
84' Frosinone fail to score from a corner as Mile Svilar (AS Roma) leaps to collect the ball.
83' The free kick is delivered by Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared. The referee blows his whistle, Frosinone are awarded a corner kick.
83' Antonio Giua interrupts the game. One of the players from AS Roma won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
82' Daniele De Rossi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Houssem Aouar (AS Roma) replacing Tommaso Baldanzi.
82' Here comes a substitution. Angelino is given a rest as he is replaced by Chris Smalling (AS Roma).
81' 0 - 3 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Stefano Turati no chance!
80' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
80' It’s a PENALTY to AS Roma after the VAR review!
79' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for AS Roma! Let's see what he decides.
78' Caleb Okoli (Frosinone) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
77' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
76' The foul by Sardar Azmoun (AS Roma) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Antonio Giua.
75' Substitution. Reinier is replaced by Enzo Barrenechea (Frosinone).
74' Diego Llorente (AS Roma) was too forceful with his tackle and Antonio Giua interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
71' 0 - 2 Goal! Sardar Azmoun (AS Roma) was in the right place at the right time to pounce on the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball home. It's 0:2.

71' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range low towards the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
71' AS Roma have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
70' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
70' The linesman signals that Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
69' AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick.
69' Sardar Azmoun (AS Roma) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) replaces Kaio Jorge.
67' Substitution. Abdou Harroui (Frosinone) has come on for Marco Brescianini.
67' Here is a change. Pol Lirola is going off and Eusebio Di Francesco gives the last tactical orders to Giuseppe Caso (Frosinone).
67' Substitution. Rasmus Kristensen makes way for Zeki Celik (AS Roma).
66' Antonio Giua shows a yellow card to Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) for his blatant foul.
66' Sardar Azmoun (AS Roma) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
65' Handball by Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone).
63' Sardar Azmoun (AS Roma) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Antonio Giua blows his whistle for a foul.

63' That's unlucky! Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) side steps a tackle after receiving a pass, advances then hits a booming shot from mid-range which only rises at the last second to fly just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Frosinone.
61' Antonio Giua blows for a foul after Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
60' Reinier (Frosinone) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.

60' Pol Lirola (Frosinone) takes a brilliant touch after he latches on to a pass on the edge of the box and strikes the ball to the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper dives low and saves his attempt.
59' Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
59' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
57' Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong.
57' Angelino (AS Roma) makes a rough challenge and Antonio Giua blows his whistle for a foul.
56' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
55' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.

54' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) gets the ball from a rebound and shoots from long range, but sends the ball high over the crossbar. The goalkeeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Very poor attempt. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
53' Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
49' AS Roma players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Dean Huijsen (AS Roma) is replaced by Diego Llorente.
46' Daniele De Rossi makes a half-time substitution. Lorenzo Pellegrini comes on in place of Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Frosinone take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
45+2' Matias Soule (Frosinone) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.

45+1' Kaio Jorge (Frosinone) jumps for a header from the corner kick, but fails to steer the ball into the goal as it flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
45+1' Frosinone work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Frosinone fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
41' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
41' Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) receives a pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Mile Svilar makes a great save to stop his effort.
41' Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone) smashes the ball from the edge of the box and misses well wide of the left post.
39' Dean Huijsen (AS Roma) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.

38' 0 - 1 Goal! Dean Huijsen (AS Roma) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box inside the right post. Stefano Turati had no chance of reaching it. The score is 0:1.
36' Sardar Azmoun (AS Roma) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

35' Kaio Jorge (Frosinone) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
35' 11:2 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
34' Kaio Jorge (Frosinone) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Antonio Giua has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
32' Kaio Jorge (Frosinone) misses the left post by a whisker with a close-range rebound. What a chance that was!
32' Kaio Jorge (Frosinone) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.

32' Kaio Jorge (Frosinone) receives a short pass inside a congested penalty area and takes a first-time shot. The effort heads towards the middle of the goal but Mile Svilar blocks the shot with his legs.
31' Frosinone take a short corner kick.
31' Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
30' A cross from Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
29' Frosinone are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
26' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Ilario Monterisi (Frosinone).
26' What a wasted chance that was! A precise cross into the box finds Reinier (Frosinone), whose header goes wide of the goal.
24' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Frosinone.

24' Matias Soule (Frosinone) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Mile Svilar makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the left side of the goal. Frosinone get a corner.
23' Matias Soule (Frosinone) unleashes a decent shot towards goal from long range, but his effort just misses the target. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.

20' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends his bullet header just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Frosinone.
18' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Frosinone is cautioned for aggressive play.
18' The ball possession is 33:67.

15' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom left corner. Stefano Turati guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
14' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
13' Antonio Giua has a clear sight and sees a foul from Bryan Cristante (AS Roma).
11' Some neat passing and movement from Frosinone as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.

8' Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) collects a wonderful lead pass and creates some space to smash the ball goalwards from long range. His shot goes painfully close to the right post! The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
7' AS Roma concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
3' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Kaio Jorge (Frosinone) makes a good run into the box to meet a cross and fires the ball in on goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender.
3' Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
3' Reinier (Frosinone) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him.
2' A quickly taken corner by Frosinone.
2' Dean Huijsen (AS Roma) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. AS Roma will have the kick-off.
Antonio Giua was nominated as the referee for this game.
